Hero_Desc_MayoCool:
Mayo, a Sprite armed with collectibles to become a source of strength for Master.
Her extensive equipment has lifted some of her gloom and given her a little confidence.
Her manner of speech, however, makes it clear that Mayo is still Mayo.
Album_Like_MayoCool: Master, the collectibles that gave her strength, a photo of her missing friend
Album_Hobby_MayoCool: Wearing her collectibles and helping Master
Album_Wish_MayoCool: To carry Master through a difficult challenge and proudly earn recognition for her abilities
Album_MayoCool1: When Mayo approached fully equipped with those bizarre devices and striking dramatic poses, I could not contain myself and burst out laughing. She became immensely proud, asking whether I was smiling so broadly because I liked her that much. Fortunately, Mayo never understood why I laughed.
Album_MayoCool2: I asked Mayo when and where she had collected all that equipment, but even she could not remember. I questioned whether someone constantly talking about collectibles was actually indifferent to them. She snickered ominously and said that whatever else she might forget, she knew everything about me.
Album_MayoCool3: On the day we agreed to meet in the Sprite Forest, Mayo arrived late for the first time since acquiring her strange equipment. Looking dazed, she explained that she could not control her tremendous speed, raced through the Sprite Forest all the way to Monatium Forest, and had to turn back. I never considered that drawback...
Album_MayoCool4: Mayo still hides somewhere nearby and watches me with a sinister air. She once chose unobtrusive positions, but her noisy equipment now makes her more conspicuous. Seeing Mayo dressed like that, snickering alone while spying on me... was honestly rather frightening.
Album_MayoCool5: Now the Sprite Kingdom's problem solver, Mayo complains that requests for help pour in from everywhere. Despite her grumbling, she immediately races to assist whenever contacted, then anxiously clutches her phone whenever no calls arrive.
Album_MayoCool6: One day, Ashur and Speaki called for help. Ashur asked Mayo to distribute store flyers, while Speaki wanted her stiff shoulders massaged after cleaning. After spending the day on errands, Mayo returned grumbling that she would become more selective about whom she helped.
Album_MayoCool7: When Ner discovered the insurance bill from Monatium, an enraged Erpin came looking for me. Believing I had informed Ner, she tried to headbutt me, but Mayo stepped between us. A tremendous crash left Erpin and Mayo unconscious. I cannot forget Mayo's faint smile upon seeing me unharmed just before she passed out.
LoveHero_MayoCool: Collectible acknowledged me! I will give it everything I have!
LoveHeroCancel_MayoCool: Ugh, Collectible, was I not good enough...?
Food_ChefNote_MayoCool_Hate1: Mayo said it was too common to have much collectible value and did not taste good either.
Food_ChefNote_MayoCool_Hate2: Mayo tried the candy despite her suspicions, then grimaced. She complained that I had deceived her and that the trick was not even amusing.
Food_ChefNote_MayoCool_Like1: Calling it a collectible object given by her Collectible, she took the entire bottle. I doubt she intends to drink it.
Food_ChefNote_MayoCool_Like2: She said she had packed one away before, so this time she ate everything. The increasing sweetness as she chewed fascinated her.
Food_ChefNote_MayoCool_Like3: She considered the special food too precious to eat. I persuaded her that storing it in her stomach was an option, and she happily allowed herself to be fooled.
Food_ChefNote_MayoCool_Like4: She seemed reluctant to eat it, but finally did after I promised to make another. A Bûche de Noël will probably appear as a decoration in Mayo's room soon.
Food_ChefNote_MayoCool_Like5: Enchanted by the sweet-and-tart flavor, Mayo emptied the dish immediately. Only afterward did she become disappointed that nothing remained to collect.
Food_ChefNote_MayoCool_Like6: Mayo was considering packing the songpyeon for her collection, but after tasting one, stuffed her mouth until her cheeks bulged. Naturally, she packed the rest.
Food_ChefNote_MayoCool_Like7: Mayo collected only the prettily shaped almond rochers. They all looked identical to me, but she insisted every shape was different.
Food_ChefNote_MayoCool_Like8: She ate half and packed half, delighted by the sparkling powder's high collectible value.
Food_ChefNote_MayoCool_Like9: She took this one for display. Apparently, the one she collected previously was for preservation.
MayoCool_Spawn1: Time to show an even cooler side of me.
MayoCool_Growth1: I am rather impressive, am I not?
MayoCool_Growth2: Thank you for looking after me.
MayoCool_Victory1: Hehe! I successfully showed you how cool I am.
MayoCool_Victory2: Nothing else for me to do? That was far too easy.
MayoCool_Defeat2: Ugh, is this not enough? Do I need another collection?
MayoCool_Affinity1_1: Collectible, do I look kind of cool?
MayoCool_Affinity1_2: Do you have anything for me to do? Easy jobs are no fun!
MayoCool_Affinity2: Just leave everything to me! I will take care of it!
MayoCool_Affinity3: Collectible, are you a little more interested in me now?
MayoCool_Affinity4: I will protect you from now on!
MayoCool_Affinity6: You want to know what is going on with these claws? That is a secret.
MayoCool_Affinity7: Collectibles, I am glad you know how much I treasure you!
MayoCool_Die1: I am a cool fairy, and I still failed?
MayoCool_Die2: Sorry I could not do better!
MayoCool_LevelUp: I have to get stronger to collect more collections!
MayoCool_Equipment: Thanks for the collection from my collection!
MayoCool_HeroSkill: Managing my collection well made me stronger!
MayoCool_HeroUpgrade: I became an even cooler, cooler Mayo!
MayoCool_Board: Is there a new collection over there?
MayoCool_DeckSetting2: I was getting restless, so I am stepping in!
MayoCool_Touch1: Ugh~ I did not do anything wrong this time, did I?
MayoCool_Touch1_1: I am stronger now. Prepare for retaliation!
MayoCool_Touch2_1: Whether my collections are here or not... do you have to pet me?
MayoCool_Touch1_2: Ah, what is your standard for deciding when to pull?
MayoCool_Touch2: Hehe, so getting stronger really does earn recognition.
MayoCool_Touch2_2: My collection's hand is my greatest treasure...
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_MayoCool_Skin1: Rumor says that whenever someone plays 'raft cruise' on Elemental Lake, an imposing captain appears wearing an expression more serious than ever.
MayoCool_Growth2_Skin1: An adventure in search of Treasure Island!
MayoCool_Equipment_Skin1: Good equipment is essential for sailing!
MayoCool_HeroSkill_Skin1: I learned even cooler sailing techniques!
MayoCool_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: Now I am an even cooler captain!
MayoCool_Board_Skin1: Is there a treasure island there?
MayoCool_Touch1_Skin1: Ugh~ Keep this up and I will throw you into the sea, okay?
MayoCool_Touch1_1_Skin1: Are you taking your seasickness out on me?
MayoCool_Touch1_2_Skin1: Is this a mutiny? I am going to get angry, you know?
MayoCool_Touch2_Skin1: Hehe~ A tribute of petting for the captain.
MayoCool_Touch2_1_Skin1: Are you wishing me a safe voyage? Hehe.
MayoCool_Touch2_2_Skin1: As warm as a sunset over the sea.
MayoCool_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: Keep this up and I will use you as a mast!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_MayoCool_Skin2: Mayo (Cool) has waited for this very moment. The meaning of her outfit is unclear, but she appears utterly determined.
MayoCool_Growth2_Skin2: With my Collectible beside me, Mayo is always cool.
MayoCool_LevelUp_Skin2: I am stronger now, so I will protect you!
MayoCool_Equipment_Skin2: The ring is enough, but I will put this to good use!
MayoCool_HeroSkill_Skin2: I have to keep getting stronger if I want to collect things!
MayoCool_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: Oh? Then what am I to my collection?
MayoCool_Board_Skin2: Rushing off to find where the collection is!
MayoCool_Touch1_Skin2: The veil is not for pulling!
MayoCool_Touch1_1_Skin2: Collection, you have to mind the situation before pulling!
MayoCool_Touch1_2_Skin2: I am only enduring it because you are the collection I chose!
MayoCool_Touch2_Skin2: Hehe, this is how a good collection should behave.
MayoCool_Touch2_1_Skin2: Mm... Maybe it is the veil, but it tickles.
MayoCool_Touch2_2_Skin2: The collection doll seems to like it too.
MayoCool_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Can you not see what I am holding?
MayoCool_AsideUpgrade: Collection... Can never escape me... Uhehehet!
MayoCool_SPSkill1: This will be hard to block.
MayoCool_No3: That is not how you do it!
MayoCool_Birthday: Today is my collection's anniversary? I like it too.
MayoCool_Gacha2: This is my new collection site from now on.
MayoCool_Line1: There should be something worth collecting around here somewhere.
MayoCool_Line2: I will find it all, collect it, and use it myself.
MayoCool_Line3: Mm, it seems to be hidden nearby.
LoveLetter_MayoCool:
Collectible, thank you for always caring about me. I dislike that you care for the other Apostles too, but because you are Master, I understand and accept it.

I know you may dislike how excessively I worry about you. By using my collectibles this time, I learned that trusting them makes me stronger. So from now on, I will trust my Collectible more. In return, you must trust me more too. Understood?
LoveCall_MayoCool:
Collectible, have you been well?
Ugh... Hearing your voice made it even worse.
You ask what I mean? Umm... Well...

Ever since you acknowledged me and called me cool, Collectible, my heart has felt strange.
W-What do you mean it was strange already?!
Ahem. Since then... I cannot stop thinking about you.
That happened before too, but this is different. It feels... deeper, softer, and warmer.
So I gathered my collectibles for an emergency meeting.
The conclusion was... I must tell my Collectible that you are my, my, my...
most wonderful collectible!
Ugh, I intended to say it in person...
but the moment I thought of it, I wanted to hear your voice immediately... so I called.

Th-Thank you for listening.
N-Now I remembered an urgent errand! I am hanging up! S-See you next time!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP01_001: This collectible is my collectible... That collectible is my collectible... Hehehe...!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP01_003: ...And of course, the collectible standing before me is my collectible too! Hehe...!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP01_004: No. Everything in the Banquet Hall belongs to me.
Affinity_MayoCool_EP01_005: Th-then I am in the Banquet Hall too, so do I belong to the collectible?!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP01_006: My, how wonderful it must be to have so many collectibles~
Affinity_MayoCool_EP01_007: Collectible, are you jealous of the other collectibles? Do not worry. You are the best of all my collectibles!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP02_001: All my other collectibles listen to me, so why will you not, Collectible?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP02_002: What have I refused to do?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP02_003: I keep telling you to let me preserve you in the display case at my house! Then you would not have to work, so you would be comfortable and I would be happy!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP02_004: Because you keep asking for strange things.
Affinity_MayoCool_EP02_005: What is strange about it? Collectibles belong on display in a case! That is a collectible's duty!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP02_007: No!!! Absolutely, absolutely not!!! I was only a little upset. I did not say I disliked my Collectible! Do not misunderstand!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP03_001: Aaaah! Emergency! This is an emergency!!!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP03_003: I spilled the food Collectible gave me on my clothing collectible! Give me anything I can wipe it with! Hurry!!!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP03_004: You spilled it on your clothes, did you not? I told you to focus on your food while eating.
Affinity_MayoCool_EP03_005: I wanted the hair stuck to Collectible's clothes before it fell off... It is hard to find once it lands on the floor...!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP03_006: That is when you need to remain calm.
Affinity_MayoCool_EP03_007: What?! I spilled food on my clothing 'collectible.' How can I stay calm?! Is this someone else's problem to you?!!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP04_001: Collectible, why do you keep laughing whenever you look at my shield collectible?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP04_002: That shield smiled at me first.
Affinity_MayoCool_EP04_003: I smile at Collectible first too. Every single day, even! But Collectible never smiles at me. Hmph...
Affinity_MayoCool_EP04_004: No matter how I look at it, it resembles Sylla...
Affinity_MayoCool_EP04_005: How does it resemble her? My shield collectible is far, far more impressive than that Wind Elemental!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP04_006: Truly, a smile seen perhaps once in a thousand years...!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP04_007: Hehehe... What about my smile? Is my smile seen only once in a thousand years too~? Hey, why are you turning away?!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP05_003: Yes! Make me one more of what I just ordered! And another glass of water, please. Hehehe~
Affinity_MayoCool_EP05_004: Wait... Did you summon me with that bell?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP05_005: Yes! I heard that this is how everyone calls the servers at restaurants in Monatium. Hehe~
Affinity_MayoCool_EP05_006: What? Where did that bell suddenly come from...?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP05_007: Ring-a-ling!! Look over here! I am shaking this bell so hard my arm could fall off because I am calling Collectible! Ring-a-ling!!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP06_001: A Beastfolk who looks like a peach keeps asking to become my apprentice and learn my secret to running. What a nuisance!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP06_002: I am curious too. How do you run so quickly?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP06_003: I simply shout 'Collectible' while running, and a wind blows from somewhere and pushes me... What? Why are you staring at me in disbelief?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP06_005: Yes. She keeps clinging to me and calling me a super-ultra-authentic ninja! It is exhausting...
Affinity_MayoCool_EP06_006: So are you going to have an apprentice now?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP06_007: No, it is nothing like that! I am not interested at all! ...Though that pink Beastfolk is a tiny bit cute...!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP07_001: Collectible! Do I look better in the blue dress, or in what I am wearing now?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP07_002: A face completes an outfit. The clothes are not what matters.
Affinity_MayoCool_EP07_003: ...Completes an outfit? I am not a tailor Sprite, so why would I do that? Just hurry and tell me which looks better!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP07_004: I do not know. They are about the same.
Affinity_MayoCool_EP07_005: Ugh, do not answer so carelessly. Look closely before you speak! ...N-no, I did not mean you should stare quite that hard...!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP07_006: Which do you think suits you better?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP07_007: Hmm... Hmmmm... Hmmmmmm... Ugh, this is too difficult to choose...! I am sorry, Collectible. I asked a question that was far too hard!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP08_001: Collectible, do I look intimidating when I scowl like this? Grr!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP08_002: If you keep doing that, you will get wrinkles between your brows.
Affinity_MayoCool_EP08_003: Wrinkles? Then could I look intimidating all the time without even having to tense my face? Oh, that is an incredible tip!!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP08_004: Oh my, how frightening! Shiver, shiver~
Affinity_MayoCool_EP08_005: Ugh, how can you say that while grinning?! Do not tease me!!!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP08_006: ...I tried scowling like you. How do I look?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP08_007: C-Collectible... Do not do that... Smile again, quickly...! Collectible looks frightening...
Affinity_MayoCool_EP09_001: Did you know? My collectibles can talk.
Affinity_MayoCool_EP09_003: Sorry, but they are done talking for today. My throat hurts terribly after one conversation with them...!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP09_004: I want to try too! Hello, Mayo's shield, bell, and clothes!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP09_005: Ahem! Let me clear my throat... Hello, Master collectible! When are you coming to live at my owner's house? Collectibles should live together! Come quickly~
Affinity_MayoCool_EP09_006: Am I included among the collectibles you mentioned?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP09_007: Hehehe... Why ask something so obvious? You speak with me more than any of the others! So there is no need to be jealous~
Affinity_MayoCool_EP10_001: Collectible, is there anything you want me to do?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP10_002: Could you wash the dishes you used?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP10_003: No, not a boring request like that! Ask me to do something extremely serious, difficult, and grand in scale!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP10_004: May I ask you to do anything?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP10_005: Of course! If it is Collectible's request, I am confident I can do anything. What is it? Tell me quickly!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP10_006: Do you know how many times you have asked me that question?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP10_007: M-many times...? But I want to solve every one of Collectible's worries and troubles with my own hands...!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP11_001: Collectible, is there anything different about me today?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP11_003: Besides that! Tell me something else! Is there nothing different? You cannot tell? I changed so many things...
Affinity_MayoCool_EP11_004: Do you know what is different about me since yesterday?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP11_005: Collectible changed the clothes you wore yesterday, your nails, shoes, lotion, and even your shampoo!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP11_006: Your hairstyle, clothes, hair tie, shoes, and headband!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP11_007: Collectible, you were paying attention to me? Why did you pretend otherwise all this time? Hehehe!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP12_001: My money keeps pouring away whenever I try to collect things! What should I do?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP12_002: Shall I introduce you to a private lender I know? Her name is Pira.
Affinity_MayoCool_EP12_003: A private lender? If I borrow money, can I buy lots of collectibles? Introduce me! ...You were joking? I got excited for nothing!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP12_004: How about selling some stolen goods to Sist?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP12_005: No! If I sell my collectibles, they will be sad! They will come looking for me every night, crying!!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP12_006: If you squander everything, you will have to sell your collectibles. Why not restrain yourself sometimes?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP12_007: Hmm... You are right! Collecting is important, but protecting the collection is important too!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP13_001: Collectible, do you have a favorite collectible?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP13_002: Mayo? Chicken mayo? Tuna mayo? Hehehe!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP13_003: Ugh, that reminded me of the ghost who tells those jokes! It is not funny!!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP13_005: Those are Collectible's collectibles? Show me too!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP13_006: I do not have one, so I thought I might begin collecting something now.
Affinity_MayoCool_EP13_007: The best collection is one filled with what you truly want! Why not start by finding something you like?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP14_001: Hmph, the ghosts keep mocking the way I speak!

Affinity_MayoCool_EP14_003: What was that?! Are you mocking me too, Collectible? Boo!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP14_004: How about punishing them with Rim's jokes?

Affinity_MayoCool_EP15_003: Could you at least pretend to be interested?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP15_004: What sort of legend is it?

Affinity_MayoCool_EP15_007: Do you not want to hear it? Why are you reacting like that? Can I not talk while eating? Fine. I will tell you after I finish.
Affinity_MayoCool_EP16_002: I suppose I am collecting Apostles...
Affinity_MayoCool_EP16_003: What does that mean? Are you gathering them to develop the Order? You mean that is similar?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP16_004: All anguish in the heart arises from desire...
Affinity_MayoCool_EP16_005: Non-possession? What is that? That sounds boring!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP16_007: Artifact cards? Spell cards? Something like a TCG? That sounds entertaining!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP17_001: I want to see the archaeologist dragon's relics...!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP17_002: It seems your character concepts overlap.
Affinity_MayoCool_EP17_003: Our character concepts overlap? Then whom do you like better, me or her?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP17_004: You must not steal Neti's relics.
Affinity_MayoCool_EP17_005: She and I are friends! We respect each other! I would never do that!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP17_007: Good idea! An adventure sounds entertaining too!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP18_001: It is troublesome when the owners come to the pawnshop looking for their collectibles!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP18_002: You must not knock them unconscious with a blowgun.
Affinity_MayoCool_EP18_003: I may be that sort of Sprite... but I do not do that to customers!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP18_005: I tell them it was already sold and compensate them with money! Once a collectible enters my hands, I protect it!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP18_006: So these are people who sold their collectibles.
Affinity_MayoCool_EP18_007: Yes. That is why I pay them and send them away. Their collectibles will like me better anyway.
Affinity_MayoCool_EP19_001: Everyone keeps introducing me to more things worth collecting! What should I do?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP19_003: That dragon is involved too! Her sales pitch tempts me! You mean I should simply stop meeting her? Oh! That sounds good!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP19_004: Mayo, do everything you want to do.
Affinity_MayoCool_EP19_005: Good! I want to! But I cannot because I do not have enough money...
Affinity_MayoCool_EP19_006: Having many things to collect is a good thing!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP19_007: Hmm? You are right! It is good to have so much to collect! I will gather it all one piece at a time!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP20_001: I found this map! Is it a treasure map?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP20_002: Anyone can see that it is clearly a treasure map!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP20_003: Collectible, you are coming with me! Hmm? You say it is dangerous outside the blankets right now?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP20_004: How about going on an adventure with Neti?
Affinity_MayoCool_EP20_005: Oh? Good idea! I will adventure with the archaeologist dragon and Marie. The person I am now can do it!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP20_006: This map marks where the Beastfolk buried their cans of feed!
Affinity_MayoCool_EP20_007: Aw, I got excited for nothing! Why would the Beastfolk make a map like this?!
